log.text: Floette used Light of Ruin → Grimmsnarl

decisions.rationale: Mega Floette intended. Lead Floette+Arcanine: T1 mega+Intimidate, LoR/Moonblast and Blitz/CC/ES into Arch/Scizor/Noivern. Back Ape (Ice Punch Scizor, CC Arch, Defiant) + Maushold (Follow Me/Friend Guard/Tidy) complete redirection and late game vs screens/sash.
decisions.notebook: Opp: Arch Stamina Leftovers Modest (ElectroShot/DM/FlashCannon/Protect) + Poli Drizzle Sitrus Modest rain (WB/HydroPump/IceBeam/Protect); Mega Scizor Adamant Technician (BulletPunch/CC/Uturn/Protect); Noivern sash Infiltrator Timid (Hurricane/DM/SuperFang/Protect). G1 left Grimm clay + Staraptor WideLens home. Scizor freezable by Ape Ice Punch; Ape CC breaks Arch through Stamina. Our core same; priority Blitz/ES Scizor, respect sash Infiltrator + potential Grimm FakeOut/screens. G2 Mega Floette; lead FloArca pressure.

decisions.rationale: Intended Mega: Scizor-Mega. Lead Grimmsnarl+Scizor-Mega: Grimmsnarl Fake Outs the biggest physical threat (Arcanine) while Scizor Protects if Arcanine is present or Bullet Punches/Close Combats if safe. Back: Staraptor KOs Arcanine (CC 2x) and Annihilape (Brave Bird 2x); Noivern outspeeds Annihilape for Hurricane 2x and Super Fang chunks tanks. Scizor-Mega walls Floette/Dragapult/Basculegion (all resisted). Avoid leading Staraptor to prevent Defiant boost on Annihilape.
decisions.notebook: Game 2 team: Grimmsnarl+Scizor-Mega lead, Staraptor+Noivern back. Scizor-Mega is sole Mega. Key matchups verified: Close Combat 2x SE vs Arcanine-Hisui, Brave Bird 2x SE vs Annihilape, Hurricane 2x SE vs Annihilape, Foul Play 2x SE vs Basculegion. Scizor-Mega resists Floette (0.25-0.5x all moves), Dragapult (0.5x Draco Meteor/Shadow Ball via Steel), Basculegion (0.5x Water+Ghost). Annihilape is immune to Fighting (Ghost type) so Scizor Close Combat useless vs it. Staraptor Intimidate must avoid Annihilape (Defiant +1). Do not lead Staraptor if Annihilape likely leads. Opponent still has unseen Dragapult (Focus Sash, Clear Body, Timid, 178-213 Speed) and Basculegion (Sitrus, Adaptability, Adamant, 98-130 Speed) — expect at least one in game 2. Opponent plays aggressively: repeated Close Combats, Floette Protects frequently (3x in 10 turns game 1). Rain core (Politoed+Archaludon) benched for game 2: unreliable per game 1 experience. For game 3 if needed: Politoed Hydro Pump 4x SE vs Arcanine-Hisui could be valuable if rain timing managed better.

selection: Light of Ruin -> foe 1 (Grimmsnarl) + Mega Evolve
decisions.rationale: Blitz still OHKOs -1 Scizor through LO; LoR OHKOs Grimm. Accept BP chip on Floette (~60-86% after Intimidate+Tech). Mega now for later. Screens/FO are the main swings.
decisions.notebook: Opp: Arch Stamina LO Modest (ElectroShot/DM/FlashCannon/Protect) + Poli Drizzle Sitrus Modest rain (WB/HydroPump/IceBeam/Protect); Mega Scizor Adamant Technician (BulletPunch/CC/Uturn/Protect); Noivern sash Infiltrator Timid (Hurricane/DM/SuperFang/Protect). G1 left Grimm clay + Staraptor WideLens. Scizor freezable by Ape Ice Punch; Ape CC breaks Arch through Stamina. Our core same; priority Blitz/ES Scizor, respect sash Infiltrator + Grimm FO/screens. G2 Mega Floette; lead FloArca pressure.

decisions.rationale: Fake Out (+3 pri) flinches Arcanine before it can Flare Blitz, preventing the guaranteed OHKO on Scizor. Scizor Mega Evolves and Close Combats Arcanine for 2x SE — even at -1 Atk from Intimidate, ~40-88% damage. If Arcanine survives, Bullet Punch next turn finishes it (ES does 0.5x to Steel). Floette may KO Grimmsnarl with Light of Ruin but that's a 1-for-1 trade favoring us since we remove the Flare Blitz threat.
decisions.notebook: Game 2 lead: Grimmsnarl+Scizor-Mega vs Floette-Eternal+Arcanine-Hisui. Arcanine Intimidate already applied (-1 Atk both). Flare Blitz guaranteed OHKO Scizor (4x SE, 179-401%). Light of Ruin vs Grimmsnarl 90.6-204.7% (possible OHKO). Close Combat vs Arcanine 56.9-125.9% pre-Intimidate/Mega modifiers. Plan: flinch Arcanine T1, Mega Evo Scizor, chip Arcanine into KO range for Bullet Punch next turn. Floette Protects frequently (game 1 data). If Grimmsnarl falls, bring Staraptor or Noivern depending on remaining foe. Staraptor avoids Annihilape (Defiant). Noivern Focus Sash + Infiltrator for Dragapult matchup. Rain core (Politoed+Archaludon) benched game 2.

decisions.rationale: Staraptor's Intimidate weakens Arcanine's Flare Blitz and Staraptor outspeeds both foes to Close Combat Arcanine (48-108%, guaranteed KO at 10%). Scizor Bullet Punch at -1 Atk still does ~11-24% to Arcanine (>10% HP). Noivern stays in back for Dragapult. Next turn: Scizor Bullet Punch KOs Arcanine, Staraptor Brave Birds Floette.
decisions.notebook: Game 2: Grimmsnarl fainted T1. Arcanine-Hisui at 10%, Floette-Mega at 38%. Scizor-Mega at 100% with -1 Atk/Def/SpD from Close Combat + Intimidate. Staraptor brought in for Grimmsnarl. Plan: T2 Scizor Bullet Punch KOs Arcanine (priority +1), Staraptor Brave Birds Floette. Endgame: Noivern (Focus Sash, Infiltrator) for Dragapult; avoid sending Staraptor into Annihilape (Defiant punishes Intimidate). Floette Protects frequently (game 1 data). Opponent back: Annihilape (Defiant, Jolly, Leftovers), Dragapult (ClearBody, Timid, FocusSash), Maushold (FriendGuard, Jolly, WideLens), Basculegion (Adaptability, Adamant, SitrusBerry).

decisions.rationale: Arcanine 10% dies to almost anything non-resisted; ES Scizor first (prio) chips through -1 and may force response while Floette Protects vs BP/BB. Surviving Floette + backline better than trading into Staraptor speed ties.

Arca dead; bring Ape into Star/Sciz. Ghost immune to both CC+FinalGambit; neutral BP; can Ice Punch weakened Scizor or RageFist. Maus weaker into Fighting spam and less immediate pressure. Floette Pass (no switch option).

Bullet Punch +1 priority guarantees Arcanine KO at 10% before it can Flare Blitz (verified). Staraptor Brave Bird on Floette at 38% has good KO odds (35-79% dmg). If Floette Protects (common per game 1), we still remove Arcanine and Staraptor takes no recoil. If Arcanine Protects, Staraptor still pressures Floette. Split targeting covers both Protect scenarios better than double-targeting either foe.
decisions.notebook: Game 2: Grimmsnarl fainted T1. Scizor-Mega at 100% with -1 Atk/Def/SpD (Close Combat drops + Intimidate). Staraptor brought in for Grimmsnarl with Intimidate active (hit both foes). Plan: T2 Scizor Bullet Punch KOs Arcanine (priority), Staraptor Brave Birds Floette. Endgame: Noivern (Focus Sash, Infiltrator) for Dragapult; avoid sending Staraptor into Annihilape (Defiant punishes Intimidate). Floette Protects frequently (game 1 data). Opponent back: Annihilape (Defiant, Jolly, Leftovers), Dragapult (ClearBody, Timid, FocusSash), Maushold (FriendGuard, Jolly, WideLens), Basculegion (Adaptability, Adamant, SitrusBerry).

selection: Protect [success rate reduced: Protected last turn]
decisions.rationale: Flo 38% dies to BP or BB; Protect (even reduced) buys turn. Ape Ice Punch 2x Staraptor—likely KO or heavy chip before/after Spe race. Scizor -1 Atk BP still threatens Flo; double Protect stalls poorly. Target Star first; Scizor outsped by both.

Brave Bird alone guarantees Floette KO (38.1% min > 38% HP). Scizor Protects to avoid Annihilape's hit at +1 Atk. If Floette Protects (reduced rate), both moves whiff but board is unchanged. Staraptor may take Ice Punch after recoil but likely survives at 76-87% vs 50-118% range. Floette removal is priority—Fairy Aura boosts Light of Ruin which threatens Scizor at 0.5x.
decisions.notebook: Game 2: Grimmsnarl fainted T1. Scizor-Mega has -1 Atk/Def/SpD (Close Combat drops + Intimidate from Arcanine). Staraptor Intimidate triggered on switch-in, giving Annihilape +1 Atk via Defiant. Floette-Mega at 38% is guaranteed KO from Staraptor Brave Bird alone. Scizor Bullet Punch at -1 Atk does ~28-51% (not guaranteed KO on 38% Floette). Annihilape Close Combat is 0.25x vs Bug/Steel. Endgame plan: Noivern (Focus Sash, Infiltrator) reserved for Dragapult; avoid sending Staraptor into Annihilape (Defiant punishes Intimidate). Opponent back: Dragapult (ClearBody, Timid, FocusSash), Maushold (FriendGuard, Jolly, WideLens), Basculegion (Adaptability, Adamant, SitrusBerry).

decisions.rationale: Floette 38% dies to Scizor Technician BP or Staraptor BB before acting; Protect streak makes it unusable. Switch to Maushold (Friend Guard). Ape Ice Punch (2x) finishes 36% Staraptor; CC also KOs but drops defs.
decisions.notebook: Opp: Arch Stamina LO Modest (ElectroShot/DM/FlashCannon/Protect) + Poli Drizzle Sitrus Modest rain (WB/HydroPump/IceBeam/Protect); Mega Scizor Adamant Technician (BulletPunch/CC/Uturn/Protect); Noivern sash Infiltrator Timid (Hurricane/DM/SuperFang/Protect). G1 left Grimm clay + Staraptor WideLens. Scizor freezable by Ape Ice Punch; Ape CC breaks Arch through Stamina. Our core same; priority Blitz/ES Scizor, respect sash Infiltrator + Grimm FO/screens. G2 Mega Floette.

decisions.rationale: Bullet Punch (priority +1) guaranteed KOs 38% Floette (42% min). Staraptor Brave Bird into Annihilape does 67.7-121.1% — possible OHKO, guaranteed crippling damage. Staraptor outspeeds Annihilape (167 vs 121-156). Staraptor likely falls to recoil+Ice Punch but trades for Floette KO + Annihilape at 0-32%. Noivern enters free next turn to Hurricane-clean surviving Annihilape (2x SE). Scizor at 85% walls all Annihilape moves (0.25-0.5x).
Automatic: only one legal joint action.

Ape 25% dies to BP (prio) or Hurricane; must Protect. Follow Me (+2) redirects their singles onto Maus so Ape is safe on a Protect read. Maus lives a BP roll; loses to Hurricane but Ape+Floette remain vs sash Noivern.
Automatic: only one legal joint action.

Protect Noivern to preserve Focus Sash and full HP for endgame vs Floette/Dragapult. Scizor Close Combat guaranteed KOs Maushold from 64% even at -1 Atk, removing redirect support. Every opponent line (Follow Me, Annihilape Protect, switch to Floette) is handled cleanly. Next turn Noivern at 100% Draco Meteors Annihilape from 24% for guaranteed KO (90% acc, 26.7% min > 24%).
decisions.notebook: Game 2: Floette-Mega is Fairy-type — immune to Draco Meteor; Noivern Hurricane is neutral vs Floette. Scizor Close Combat at -1 Atk guaranteed KOs Maushold from 64% (68.5% min). Scizor Bullet Punch at -1 Atk does 28-51% to Floette — not a reliable KO from 38%. Noivern Draco Meteor (90% acc, neutral) guaranteed KOs Annihilape from 24% (26.7% min). Annihilape Close Combat is 0.25x vs Bug/Steel Scizor. Opponent back: Dragapult (ClearBody, Timid, FocusSash, not brought g2), Basculegion (Adaptability, Adamant, SitrusBerry, not brought g2). Endgame: preserve Noivern Focus Sash for Dragapult matchup in game 3 if needed.

decisions.rationale: Scizor BP KOs either active from current HP (Technician net with -1 Atk). Their cleanest line is Hurricane Ape + BP Floette. Floette Protect blocks that BP and keeps our wincon; Ape CC exploits Scizor -2 Def for a likely KO if Noivern does not also remove Ape. LoR recoil unsafe at 38%.
decisions.notebook: Opp: Arch Stamina LO Modest (ElectroShot/DM/FlashCannon/Protect) + Poli Drizzle Sitrus Modest rain (WB/HydroPump/IceBeam/Protect); Mega Scizor Adamant Technician (BulletPunch/CC/Uturn/Protect); Noivern sash Infiltrator Timid (Hurricane/DM/SuperFang/Protect). G1 left Grimm clay + Staraptor WideLens. Scizor freezable by Ape Ice Punch; Ape CC breaks Arch through Stamina. Our core same; priority Blitz/ES Scizor, respect sash Infiltrator + Grimm FO/screens. G2 Mega Floette. Scizor -Atk/-Def/-SpD from CCs.

decisions.rationale: Noivern outspeeds both foes and Draco Meteor guaranteed KOs Annihilape from 30% (90% acc). Scizor Bullet Punch (priority) does 37.6-84.6% to Floette — very likely KOs from 38%. If both hit, we win immediately. Even if Draco misses, Noivern's Focus Sash absorbs one hit. Floette's attacks on Scizor are all NVE (0.25-0.5x), so Scizor doesn't need Protect. Opponent has no bench remaining, so no switches to worry about.
decisions.notebook: Game 2 endgame: Noivern Draco Meteor guaranteed KOs Annihilape from 24% (26.7% min, neutral Dragon vs Fighting/Ghost). Scizor Bullet Punch at -1 Atk does 37.6-84.6% to Floette-Mega — likely KOs from 38%. Floette-Mega Fairy attacks are 0.5x on Bug/Steel Scizor-Mega. Opponent back for game 3: Dragapult (ClearBody, Timid, FocusSash, 178-213 Spe) and Basculegion (Adaptability, Adamant, SitrusBerry, 98-130 Spe). Preserve Noivern Focus Sash for Dragapult speed tie/matchup in game 3 if needed.

decisions.rationale: Alone at 38%. Scizor BP pri SE likely KOs; Noivern outspeeds. Must pressure sash Noivern now with LoR (Fairy Aura) before BP; Moonblast weaker. Protect fails often after consecutive. Pass only on fainted Ape.

BP min roll 42% > Floette 38% HP = guaranteed KO at priority +1. Floette can't outspeed it. Only ~8% Protect blocks it; even then we retry next turn. Super Fang is backup if somehow BP misses KO. This wins game 2 and the series 2-0.
decisions.notebook: Game 2 won: Scizor-Mega Bullet Punch guaranteed KO on Floette-Mega from 38% (42% min roll > 38% HP) at priority +1. Series won 2-0. No game 3 needed. For future reference: Floette-Mega Protect used 3 times by turn 6, 4th use ~8% success. Opponent back (unused): Dragapult FocusSash Timid 178-213 Spe ClearBody; Basculegion SitrusBerry Adamant 98-130 Spe Adaptability.

reflections.summary: Lost due to flawed preview: Mega Floette + Hisui Arcanine into Mega Scizor (Fairy resisted; BP priority SE) left Floette a liability and ES/Blitz ineffective, collapsing the game.
reflections.adjustment: G3 avoid Mega Floette vs Scizor; bring a Scizor-pressure core (Ape Ice Punch/CC) and respect their Grimm/Staraptor screens + sash Noivern mode instead.
reflections.notebook: Opp: Arch Stamina LO Modest (ElectroShot/DM/FlashCannon/Protect) + Poli Drizzle Sitrus Modest rain (WB/HydroPump/IceBeam/Protect); Mega Scizor Adamant Technician (BulletPunch/CC/Uturn/Protect); Noivern sash Infiltrator Timid (Hurricane/DM/SuperFang/Protect); Grimm clay Prankster (Reflect/LS/FakeOut/FoulPlay); Staraptor WideLens Intimidate (BraveBird/CC/FinalGambit/Protect). G1 rain (Arch/Poli/Scizor/Noivern); G2 screens (Grimm/Staraptor/Scizor/Noivern). Scizor freezable by Ape Ice Punch; Ape CC breaks Arch through Stamina. ES/Blitz weak into Scizor; respect sash Infiltrator + Grimm FO/screens. Avoid Mega Floette into Scizor (BP SE, Fairy resisted).

reflections.summary: Won through Scizor-Mega priority Bullet Punch cleaning up weakened targets (Arcanine, Maushold, Floette-Mega) and Noivern's Draco Meteor finishing Annihilape. Staraptor's Brave Bird softened Annihilape for the KO. Opponent's Floette-Mega over-relied on Protect (3 uses by turn 6), becoming predictable and letting Scizor pick it off at 38% with priority. Grimmsnarl contributed little visible value before fainting.
reflections.adjustment: For game 3, consider whether Grimmsnarl's slot is justified — its screens and Fake Out didn't visibly impact this game. If keeping it, lead it more aggressively for early Fake Out + screen pressure. Also prepare for opponent possibly bringing Dragapult or Basculegion next game instead of the same four; Noivern outspeeds Dragapult but must avoid Draco Meteor into Clear Body (no SpA drop value).
reflections.notebook: Series tied 1-1; game 3 needed. Game 2 won: Scizor-Mega Bullet Punch priority sweep cleaned Arcanine/Maushold/Floette-Mega; Noivern Draco Meteor KO'd Annihilape. Opponent game 2 brought: Annihilape (Leftovers, Jolly, Ice Punch/Rage Fist/Close Combat/Protect, Defiant), Maushold (WideLens, Jolly, Follow Me/Tidy Up/Population Bomb/Protect, Friend Guard), Floette-Mega (Floettite, Modest, Moonblast/Light of Ruin/Energy Ball/Protect, Fairy Aura), Arcanine-Hisui (Life Orb, Jolly, Flare Blitz/Close Combat/Extreme Speed/Protect, Intimidate). Opponent bench (unused g2): Dragapult FocusSash Timid ClearBody; Basculegion SitrusBerry Adamant Adaptability. Opponent tendency: Floette-Mega spams Protect (3 uses by turn 6, 4th ~8% success); Annihilape uses Protect liberally. Plan g3: Scizor-Mega priority is MVP vs this team; Staraptor Brave Bird softens Annihilape; Noivern Draco Meteor for Annihilape KO. Watch for roster swap — Dragapult outspeeds Scizor-Mega, Basculegion hits Scizor super-effectively.
